title: Love Dining Restaurants Terms and Conditions
review_note: All 8 pages reviewed against the October 2026 PDF. The retained September PDF was diffed: Sen of Japan replaces Oud in the eve-of-occasion list and joins the F1 list, gets new exclusions and dates, L'Angélus adds a 24 Oct closure and The Cliff keeps only its closure note.

clauses.title: Eligible Card and payment
clauses.summary: The Card Member must pay with an eligible Singapore-issued basic or supplementary physical Card.

clauses.title: 2026 programme period
clauses.summary: The programme runs from 1 Jan through 31 Dec 2026 unless Amex states otherwise.

clauses.title: Physical Card verification
clauses.summary: A physical Card is required at payment; digital payment is invalid unless the merchant advises otherwise.

clauses.title: Savings by party size
clauses.summary: Dine-in à la carte lunch or dinner food savings are 15% for 1 diner, 50% for 2, 35% for 3, 25% for 4 and 20% for 5–20.

clauses.title: Minimum main-course order
clauses.summary: Except for solo diners, parties must order at least two main courses unless merchant-specific terms state otherwise; sharing one main reduces savings to 15%.

clauses.title: Promotional-menu exclusion
clauses.summary: Promotional menus are excluded unless merchant-specific terms state otherwise; diners should confirm which dishes qualify as mains.

clauses.title: Party and billing limit
clauses.summary: Parties above 20 receive no savings. One Card applies per table, party and occasion; related diners cannot split bills or evade the rule with nearby tables.

clauses.title: General exclusions and availability
clauses.summary: Private events, takeaway, other promotions and special events are excluded. Reservations are first-come, subject to availability, and outlet conditions can change.

clauses.title: Programme amendment and liability
clauses.summary: Amex may amend or withdraw benefits without notice and disclaims responsibility for loss, injury or damage arising from programme-service failures or defects.

clauses.title: Voucher custody and value
clauses.summary: Vouchers expire on their stamped date, are not replaced if lost, are non-transferable and non-refundable, have no cash value, and remain subject to printed merchant terms.

clauses.title: Children in diner headcount
clauses.summary: For à la carte or set menus, ages 7+ count as adults; ages 1–6 count communally. Buffet child-counting varies by restaurant and must be confirmed.

clauses.title: Universal blackout dates
clauses.summary: All restaurants exclude public holidays, their eves, Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day and Father’s Day.

clauses.title: Selected-outlet blackout dates
clauses.summary: Named outlets have additional CNY, special-occasion, Easter, NDP Preview and 9–11 Oct 2026 Formula One exclusions.

clauses.title: Bacha Coffee conditions
clauses.summary: Requires two food items from the chef-presented à la carte menu. Named categories, sets, promotions, third-party bookings and F1 are excluded; advance booking is weekday-only and bounded.

clauses.title: Barossa Bar & Grill VivoCity conditions
clauses.summary: Requires two qualifying mains from the Love Dining à la carte Mains, Josper Grill or Pasta categories.

clauses.title: Broth & Beyond conditions
clauses.summary: Requires two qualifying mains or Market Table, booking one day ahead and identifying the offer. Broths, desserts, drinks, sets, promotions and named live seafood are excluded.

clauses.title: Cultivate Cafe conditions
clauses.summary: Requires two à la carte mains and advance booking; beverages, set menus and promotional menus are excluded.

clauses.title: GupShup conditions
clauses.summary: Requires two mains from named categories and booking 24 hours ahead; drinks, sets, promotions and third-party bookings are excluded.

clauses.title: Harry’s conditions
clauses.summary: Requires two qualifying mains. Named premium or sharing items, Changi outlets and F1 are excluded; menus vary by outlet and payment must use a physical Card at the counter.

clauses.title: JING Hotpot & Grill Buffet conditions
clauses.summary: Applies to the lunch or dinner buffet total food bill with one buffet per person. Premium meat enhancements, drinks and promotions are excluded and booking is by phone. Ages 5 and below dine free, ages 6–12 on child buffet pricing do not count, and ages 13+ count.

clauses.title: L’Angélus conditions
clauses.summary: Closed for a private event on 24 Oct 2026 with no Love Dining that day. Otherwise requires two mains from Main Dishes or Fish & Shellfish; drinks, promotions, sets, starters, sharing dishes and pre-order specials are excluded.

clauses.title: Les Bouchons conditions
clauses.summary: Requires two qualifying mains. Named 2026 Valentine’s, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Formula One and 11–31 Dec Christmas periods are excluded.

clauses.title: Les Bouchons menu categories
clauses.summary: Qualifying categories vary by branch; beverages, promotional or set menus and items on the linked exclusion list do not qualify.

clauses.title: Napoleon conditions
clauses.summary: Five named premium charcuterie or caviar items and bookings through third-party sites or apps are excluded.

clauses.title: Peach Garden conditions
clauses.summary: Requires two qualifying mains from specified à la carte or dim sum categories.

clauses.title: Santi’s conditions
clauses.summary: Qualifying mains are limited to named From The Oven dishes, sourdough pizzas or sandwiches, and pasta.

clauses.title: Sarai conditions
clauses.summary: Requires two mains from named categories; drinks, sets, buffet, promotions and linked exclusion-list items do not qualify.

clauses.title: Sen of Japan menu
clauses.summary: Only Mains, Sashimi and Sushi Platters qualify, excluding eight named premium dishes. NDP Previews, 9–11 Oct 2026 Formula One and the 2027 Valentine’s, Mother’s Day and Father’s Day periods are excluded.

clauses.title: Si Chuan Dou Hua minimum order
clauses.summary: For two or more diners, savings require three dishes, excluding appetisers, soup, dim sum or snacks, dessert and beverages.

clauses.title: Tajimaya conditions
clauses.summary: Requires two qualifying mains from named meat categories and booking at least one day ahead with the Amex offer identified.

clauses.title: TANOKE conditions
clauses.summary: Requires two mains from named categories; drinks, sets, promotions, four premium items and add-ons are excluded.

clauses.title: Tapas24 conditions
clauses.summary: Requires two qualifying mains from Meat, Skewers, Seafood, Plancha and Stoves, or Paella.

clauses.title: The Cliff conditions
clauses.summary: The Cliff is closed for renovation from 24 Sep to 6 Dec 2026 and Love Dining does not apply then. The PDF no longer lists its menu terms or occasion dates.

clauses.title: Vineyard exclusions
clauses.summary: Named premium mains and sharing plates do not qualify.

clauses.title: Wooloomooloo menu conditions
clauses.summary: Requires booking one day ahead and applies only to the S$168++ Amex four-course menu; third-party bookings, private events and Formula One are excluded.

clauses.title: Wooloomooloo voucher conditions
clauses.summary: Voucher use needs advance notice and S$250 pre-tax and service spend Sunday–Thursday, and cannot combine with Love Dining savings, promotions or blackouts.

clauses.title: Xin Cuisine conditions
clauses.summary: Third-party bookings are excluded and the merchant may impose additional special-event blackout dates.

clauses.title: Yellow Pot conditions
clauses.summary: Requires two mains from specified categories and booking 24 hours ahead; drinks, sets, promotions and third-party bookings are excluded.

clauses.title: October 2026 update statement
clauses.summary: The document states that its information was correct when updated in October 2026.
